answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) can respond to diverse queries due to the ability of in-context learning and instruction following, providing a new way to realize the controllable generation of personalized math problems.

answer_2.quote: Using reverse reasoning, we generate problem generation prompt for each problems based on these three annotations... We use GPT-4o to evaluate generated problems across eight dimensions...

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o to evaluate generated problems across eight dimensions: language fluency (LF), logical correctness (LC), content completeness (CC), knowledge relevance (KR), difficulty appropriateness (DA), type adaptability (TA), analysis completeness (AC), and answer accuracy (AA)... The self-play mechanism (SPM) ensures data quality through adversarial generation and validation by the model itself...
